item.title: PDA quota, dole for jobless, caste survey: Decoding Akhilesh Yadav's big manifesto promises for UP
item.description: Akhilesh Yadav has unveiled an ambitious manifesto for the upcoming 2027 Uttar Pradesh assembly elections, focusing on creating 25 lakh government jobs and providing Rs 5,000 monthly assistance for unemployed graduates. The manifesto champions caste representation and women's safety while fostering a diverse coalition. Additional proposals include waiving farmers' loans and investing substantially in rural infrastructure, particularly targeting the youth and various communities in Uttar Pradesh.
item.dc:creator: Pallavi

item.title: 'Rahul must apologise': Nitin Nabin targets Congress over Ambedkar at Patna event
item.description: At the Samvidhan Gaurav Diwas event in Patna, BJP national president Nitin Nabin took aim at Congress leader Rahul Gandhi, accusing him of belittling Dr. BR Ambedkar's legacy and compromising constitutional values. He pointed out Congress's troubling past of dismissing elected state governments, while commending Prime Minister Narendra Modi for his commitment to constitutional ideals.
item.dc:creator: Aryan Singh

item.title: ‘Spare 15 minutes to understand its spirit’: Amit Shah takes swipe at Rahul Gandhi on Constitution Day
item.description: Amit Shah highlighted the importance of instilling the values of the Constitution among India's youth during Constitution Day. He noted that the spirit of the Constitution was overlooked after Independence until November 26 was declared Constitution Day in 2015. Shah recounted the sacrifices made during the freedom struggle, which culminated in the Constitution.
item.dc:creator: Yashasvi Vasistha

item.title: Accredited vs self-proclaimed: SC to examine protection for journalists
item.description: The Supreme Court is set to review protection levels for accredited journalists compared to self-proclaimed reporters. It has referred the cases involving journalist assaults during protests in Delhi to a high-powered committee. The committee will investigate claims that journalists were unlawfully detained and faced excessive force from police. The Delhi Police has classified established journalists separately from social media content creators regarding protest protections.
item.dc:creator: Trisha Mahajan

item.title: 'Single-digit parties': Punjab Congress president takes a dig at BJP-SAD alliance
item.description: Pargat Singh, the president of Punjab Congress, forecasts that the BJP and Shiromani Akali Dal alliance will struggle, projecting they might secure only single-digit seats in the upcoming elections. He attributes this forecast to lingering public discontent from past events such as the farmers' protest. Singh also denounces the Aam Aadmi Party as the 'East India Company' and rules out any potential alliance with them.
item.dc:creator: Aryan Singh

item.title: 'Prayed for death every night': Azam Khan gets emotional about his time in jail
item.description: Azam Khan expressed his emotional turmoil regarding his imprisonment during the launch of the SP manifesto. He recalled the fear experienced during jail transfers, emphasizing the pain endured by his family. Khan criticized the government for their treatment and compared it to times of British rule. He reaffirmed his support for Akhilesh Yadav ahead of the upcoming 2027 elections.
item.dc:creator: Trisha Mahajan

item.title: ‘Modi is sitting quietly today’: Kharge hints at BJP top brass rift, jibes at Yogi over PM ambitions
item.description: Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge expressed gratitude towards the people of Uttar Pradesh for reducing the BJP's electoral prospects. He highlighted that the BJP's promise of winning over 400 seats is now in jeopardy. Kharge criticized the rising inflation and unemployment while questioning the source of the BJP's considerable funding. Additionally, he accused the BJP of misusing investigative agencies to gather money.
item.dc:creator: Yashasvi Vasistha

item.title: Rs 5 canteen, 50% PDA quota in govt contracts: Akhilesh unveils SP's UP manifesto
item.description: Akhilesh Yadav has unveiled the Samajwadi Party's PDA manifesto on Constitution Day ahead of the upcoming UP Assembly elections. The manifesto emphasizes the party's focus on backward classes, Dalits, and minorities, aiming to connect with diverse societal groups. By releasing it early, the SP intends to communicate its commitments effectively before the campaign begins. The party plans to contest the 2027 elections in alliance with Congress against the BJP.
item.dc:creator: Rajeev Singh

item.title: 'Elected to work, not gossip': Supriya Sule rejects NDA buzz, CM post speculation
item.description: Supriya Sule addressed rumors about her party's potential alliance with the BJP-led NDA. She emphasized her commitment to fulfilling her responsibilities to the people of Baramati and her work in Parliament. Sule also announced her father Sharad Pawar's hospitalization due to dehydration, attributing it to his busy schedule. She raised concerns about Pune's high crime rates and stressed the importance of accountability in the police.
item.dc:creator: Rajeev Singh

item.title: 'Focus on action, not words': Congress chief Mallikarjun Kharge breaks silence on Imran Masood's aggressive SP attack over UP seat-sharing
item.description: Congress chief Mallikarjun Kharge has urged party member Imran Masood to prioritize proactive strategies rather than criticism amid seat-sharing disputes with the Samajwadi Party. Masood expressed his dissatisfaction over the SP's abrupt candidate declarations during their negotiations. With rising tensions, he has challenged the SP's approach towards Congress within this alliance, showcasing the fragile dynamics as they prepare for the upcoming 2027 elections.
item.dc:creator: Rajeev Singh

item.title: Delhi high court rejects Lalu Yadav family's pleas, upholds charges in IRCTC hotel scam
item.description: The Delhi high court has affirmed the decision of the trial court to frame charges against Lalu Prasad Yadav and his family. The trial court ordered that they face charges related to corruption, conspiracy, and cheating in the IRCTC hotel scam. Lalu Prasad Yadav's family challenged this decision, arguing insufficient evidence against them. The CBI alleged that hotel leasing irregularities occurred during Lalu Prasad Yadav's tenure as Union railway minister.
item.dc:creator: Rajeev Singh

item.title: Vijay govt announces 15-day paternity leave for govt employees for first time
item.description: In a progressive move, Tamil Nadu has approved 15 days of paternity leave for male government employees, effective from a specified date. Fathers can use this leave either 15 days before their child arrives or within six months after birth. Acknowledging the crucial support fathers provide during this time, this decision encourages shared responsibilities in childcare and fosters gender equality in the family dynamic.
item.dc:creator: Aryan Singh

item.title: SC asks Centre to submit census SOPs on caste data collection within a week
item.description: The Supreme Court has directed the Centre to establish a standard operating procedure for conducting the census. This directive comes in light of a plea that raises important questions about the collection of caste-related data. The petitioner seeks assurance on the methodology used and the privacy of individual details. Additionally, an affidavit outlining the verification process for caste information is required.
item.dc:creator: Aastha Jha

item.title: Hexagons for nutrients: Supreme court asks FSSAI to tighten front packet labelling
item.description: The Supreme Court has instructed the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India to change nutrient labeling practices. It mandated the use of total sugars and saturated fat in front-of-package labels for packaged foods. The court has also directed specific warning labels for high fat, sugar, and salt on these products. Furthermore, the FSSAI must reformulate the threshold levels for these nutrients.
item.dc:creator: Pranjal Pandey
